title: Patch: the card, pile, stack and hero sheets close by the same ✕ as every dialog
notes: Follow-up to #3367's after-merge spot-check: the inspect overlay's other modal sheets (a card's touch sheet, a pile's list, a face-down card, the Stack's wheel and hero inspect) take DialogClose, the ✕ every dialog closes by, in place of their text Close, and R3221000 drops their exception. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.
